C08-M10-L04-F1.title: Comparing one observation on several baseline dimensions
C08-M10-L04-F1.caption: Synthetic data. WS-303's 52.0 MB transfer looks ordinary against the peer maximum but deviates on its own history and on destination rarity.
C08-M10-L04-F1.alt: A table with four columns: comparison, baseline value, observed value and reading. Against its own median of 7.0 MB and its own maximum of 18.5 MB, WS-303's 52.0 MB is new behavior. Against the peer maximum of 61.0 MB it looks ordinary, but that peak came from a month-end upload, so the comparison misleads on its own. No peer contacted the destination, so it is rare. Together the comparisons support escalation for validation.
